summary.name: Bad Times AI
summary.one_liner: A paid browser tool that turns one photo of a person or pet into a ~15-second vertical quarrel/lip-sync dance MP4 in the style of the "Bad Times" dance trend.
use_cases: Make a short quarrel-style dance clip from a single photo
Create a vertical lip-sync video of a pet
Join the Bad Times dance trend with an AI version of yourself
Generate a ~15 second 9:16 video for TikTok or Reels
Produce a one-off AI dance short without a subscription
summary.what_it_does: The site takes one clear photo of an adult person or a pet, with the face visible, and generates a roughly 15-second 9:16 MP4 of a quarrel or lip-sync dance based on the Bad Times trend. Output includes original AI ambient audio rather than the commercial song. Video is sold in credit packs: $6.90 buys 50 credits for one 480p Standard video, and higher packs give 720p HD videos. Failed generations automatically return credits. The page also lists a catalog prompt, a sample gallery, and tips on photo framing, with person templates limited to adults 18+ with likeness rights.
notable: One photo in, ~15s 9:16 MP4 out, with original AI ambient audio
Pay-once credit packs with no subscription, checkout via Stripe
Independent fan tool, not affiliated with the song's artist or TikTok creators
caveats: Not free: packs start at $6.90 one-time, and the page says it is not a free generator
Person templates are restricted to adults 18+ with likeness rights; no celebrities or strangers
Browser only, no native app; renders take a few minutes and download links expire in about 24 hours
